proof:
classical
obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := h_T005.2.2.1
have hE : ∀ (i j : Ix l) (c : ℂ),
    matrixUnit B i j (c • B j) = c • B i := by
  intro i j c
  simp [matrixUnit, Module.Basis.coord_apply]
have hle : ∀ i j : Ix l, J p M (ev y v i.val) ≤ J p M (ev y v j.val) := by
  intro i j c hc
  change c • ev y v i.val ∈ L p M at hc
  change c • ev y v j.val ∈ L p M
  have hpres := (h_T008.2.2.2 B hB j i).2 (c • ev y v i.val) hc
  rw [← hB i, hE, hB j] at hpres
  exact hpres
intro i
let z : Ix l := ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ l.toNat⟩
exact le_antisymm (hle i z) (hle z i)
